tittel: On "Teaching in Operation" in Higher Vocational Education
kilde: Journal of Changsha Aeronautical Vocational and Technical College
sammendrag: This paper briefly expounds the pith of the educational ideology —integration of teaching,learning and and its connotation,and argues that higher vocational education should be practice-centered,the teachers should learn how to teach in students' operation and thus integration of teaching,learning and operation is achieved.Further,the paper proposes the way to achieve such teaching thought.

tittel: The Hierarchical Teaching of Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: In order to be better adaptability of the social needs to the high vocational students,there is a need of hierarchical teaching. This article talks about the conception,necessity,principles,ways and the issues.

tittel: On the Sustainable Development of Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: Higher vocational education system is an important component of higher education.At present,the development of higher vocational education is supported by the government's macroand micro-strategic guidance policy.However,higher vocational institutions are facing enormous challenges,such as their own viability,environment and development potential.In the backgrounds of both opportunities and challenges of the times,every manager and teacher of vocational college should face such a profound question,that is,how to achieve sustainable development of the higher vocational institutions.This article holds that the sustainable development of higher vocational institutions need to be contered with human resources,through the concept innovation education,the education system innovation,mode innovation,personnel training mode innovation and teaching mode to achieve sustainable development innovation of higher vocational institutions.

tittel: On Cultivation of Higher Vocational Education Teachers
Exploration on the Development of Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: Higher vocational education is the product of the development of social science and technology as well as the result of growing demand for all lines of social occupation.It also plays an important role in higher education system.In order to meet the needs of the country's developing economy and develop it in a healthy,steady and rapid step,we should solve three major problems: firstly,to define the orientation of higher vocational education;secondly,to reform and perfect higher vocational education;thirdly,to put emphasis on all-round development and quality-oriented education.

tittel: A Prospective Future of Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: The essay dated back the development stage of China's higher vocational education in the new era,proposing that the higher vocational education should only be well-executed by establishing ideals as to marketing,talents nurturing,quality improvement,eternal education,internationalization and innovation.The stark higher vocational schooling features should be incarnated in advanced ideals and specific majors,the innovative nurturing modes and the teaching staff with dual certificates,the well-constructed practical training bases and flexible mechanism.Predicting that China's education in the new era will embody on the socialization,externalization,successive models and legalization.

tittel: Analysis on Portugal's Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: As a Western Europe country, Portugal’s higher vocational education has an unique system and characteristic compares with other Europe countries. Along with the integration advancement of European, Portugal's higher vocational education has also carried on many reforms. Based on the investigation and research when the author was a visiting scholar at Lisbon Technical University of Portugal, this article synthesis elaborated the situation, characteristic and the development of Portugal’s higher vocational education.

tittel: Understanding higher vocational education in China
sammendrag: From a neoinstitutionalist perspective, this chapter argues that various challenges confronting the development of higher vocational education as a means of skill formation have mainly resulted from the absence of institutional legitimacy at all levels—regulative, normative, and cultural-cognitive, especially the last one. Therefore, how to help higher vocational education gain its legitimacy, especially cultural-cognitive legitimacy, is the key to future skill formation policymaking. Based on major concepts of neoinstitutionalism, including institutional legitimacy, institutional environments, and institutional isomorphism, features of higher vocational education as an emergent institution are summarized as absent legitimacy at all levels, incomplete formation of institutional environments, and non-essential isomorphic changes. In order to help higher vocational education gain its institutional legitimacy to resolve various challenges impeding its sound development, three policy foci are recommended for future skill formation policymaking: A Confucian–human capital approach, a framework for social justice, and the decisive role of the central government.

tittel: The Language Teaching of the Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: The higher vocational education is the education than pass on the student specialzed knowledge and skill.we should pay more attention to the development of the skill.respecting the personality of the student and carrying on the language teaching in a planned and a key way.

tittel: Discussion on the Modularization of Higher Vocational Education
kilde: Journal of Huainan Vocational & Technical College
sammendrag: There is a certain gap between the management of higher vocational education and employees demand in enterprises.According to the objective of service,the guiding principle of getting jobs,this paper uses modern sales theory to analyze the problems existing in management of higher vocational education,and puts forward that we should update ideas,locate scientifically,and definite the direction of running the school on the basis of employment market demanding,then the contradiction of supply and demand could be solved efficiently.

tittel: On the Curriculum Pattern in Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: Mode of training courses is the key.This paper analyzes the advanced mode of higher education,compared with the typical domestic higher education model as well as the problems on this basis,and points out the development trend of vocational education course model.

tittel: Proposal on the Development of Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: The paper brings some problems in the development of higher vocational education to attention.It argues that these problems may undermine the service capacity of higher vocation education.Thus,various countermeasures should be taken.

tittel: Discussion on Reform of Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: To run the higher vocational education vigorously and characteristically, the major layout is foundation, curriculum layout is core, teacher team building is precondition, and practical teaching is guarantee.

tittel: Higher Vocational Education Based on Constructivism
kilde: Journal of Huzhou Vocational and Technological College
sammendrag: Based on the central idea of the educational theory of constructivism, which takes the students as the core, the higher vocational college should combine the vocational meaning with the whole teaching process, and set up the bracket help system and the system of the reciprocity about the enrollment statement, the teaching process of the college and the demand of the society profession in order to train the students' lifetime learning ability, help to form the positive and upward self-identity and make higher vocational education form its own characteristics and advantages.

tittel: On the Position of the Stage of Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: Higher Vocational Education is the result of the educational popularization and industrial modernization,it is also the component of higher education.The development of higher vocational education must be analysized comprehensively according to the educational development level,social demand,and the quality need,evaluation level,the trend of the development of international higher vocational education in the course of the industrial modernization.We must look for the corresponding stage,and consummate the system of higher vocational education

tittel: Teaching Management in Higher Vocational Education
kilde: Journal of Shandong Institute of Commerce and Technology
sammendrag: Teaching management is the keystone of the successful completion of teaching.Teaching management in higher vocational education has its particularities.It deals with neither high school students nor undergraduates.It is higher vocational college students that it deals with who need to master technological skills.Therefore,teaching management towards them should be changed accordingly.In this regard,therefore,this thesis Analyzes from three aspects of teaching how to achieve effective management,and provide some instances and inspiration of problems in the course of teaching management for the staff of teaching management.

tittel: Higher Vocational Education Reform of Computer
sammendrag: With the rapid development of information technology is profoundly changing people's economic activities,scientific and technological innovation and the daily life patterns,the performance of its main activities in the socio-economic information management;people's daily life information and computer technology has become non-or missing part;because the computer has been deep into the national life and industry in every corner of College Computer professionals increasingly expanding area of work,derived from many multi-disciplinary talent,so computer professionals and non-computer professionals in the to draw a line between being vague.Computer reform will face unprecedented challenges.

tittel: Research on the Prospects of Higher Vocational Education
kilde: Journal of Inner Mongolia University for Nationalities
sammendrag: Magnificent achievements have been made in higher vocational education due to the past decades' development.However,with the technological transformation and upgrading in domestic enterprises,the former higher vocational education mode does not meet the present needs of the development of the society any more.And this leads to a great shortage of senior and junior technicians,which severely affects the sustainable development and core competitiveness of these enterprises.This paper analyses the existing problems in China's current vocational education in an attempt to solve the problems facing China's higher vocational education by means of the transformation of the cultivation guidelines and cultivation mode.

tittel: On Higher Vocational Education Teaching Reform
kilde: Liaoning Higher Vocational Technical Institute Journal
sammendrag: Higher vocational education has offered technological manpower for China's new-type industrialization, and promoted transformation of scientific and technical results. Facing social development with rapid change, higher vocational education teaching needs new guidelines and reform scheme.

tittel: On the reform of teaching in higher vocational education
kilde: Journal of Henan Vocation-Technical Teachers University
sammendrag: With the rapid development of the Chinese economy,the society has put forward new demands toward higher vocational education.Therefore,the key points of advance the development of the higher vocational education are the implementing of the reform of the teaching in higher vocational colleges and the improvement of teaching level.This article begins with the strengthening of the central position of teaching and discusses the multiple points such as the teaching orientation,the moral work,the teaching reform,the construction of training bases,the formation of some core subjects,the evaluating system on teaching,the persons qualified to teach,etc.

tittel: Thoughts on the Development of Higher Vocational Education
kilde: Journal of Jiangsu University of Science and Technology
sammendrag: The position of higher vocational education should be confirmed.The establishment of specialities and training mode should be closely connected with the local economy.The practice of the system of two-certificate or one diploma with multi-certificate is helpful to the job competitiveness and higher vocational education with unique characteristics.

tittel: Curriculum construction of higher vocational education
kilde: Journal of Harbin Vocational & Technical College
sammendrag: Compared with the higher education with record of formal schooling,the higher vocational education started later.At present,there are some phenomena of aging Knowledge,outdated and backward methods and the disjunction of the theory and the practice in teaching content and methods.So,the only way for the development of higher vocational education is to carry out a reform of curriculum.This paper takes the elementary course in Machine Manufacture as an example to discuss the train of thought of the curriculum reform.

tittel: On the Teaching Reform of Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: In cultivating high technology talents who are of strong social adaptation,a certain major theoretical level and higher expertise is the right duty of higher vocational education.As the higher vocational education developed rapidly in the new situation,market-orientated higher vocational education should focus on its market demand;Skill training as the core of higher vocational education should center its strength;Quality assurance should ensure its high;Vocational teaching reform as a means should keep its flexibility;Feature education as a premise should pursue its innovation.So the strengthening of teaching reform and the improvement of teaching quality are of especially important meaning in higher vocational education.

tittel: On the Instructional Design of Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: The design of classroom instruction was discussed in the light of the basic contents of teaching design and the characteristics of higher vocational education and students.

tittel: On sustainable development of higher vocational education
sammendrag: The main factors that curb the sustainable development of higher vocational education can be cited as follows: excessively outnumbered vocational institutes,rising cost,unsuitable system of expenses input,needy students,the lag of construction for teachers qualified both in technical theory and skills,and the lack of transitive media,etc.Only by solving the above problems can the goal of sustainable development be achieved.

tittel: On Teaching Reform of Higher Vocational Education
kilde: Journal of Huainan Vocational & Technical College
sammendrag: Practical Teaching System is an important aspect in the formation of students' General quality and their vocational and technical capabilities.This paper,by analyzing the problems of the traditional practice of teaching system,puts forward a corresponding reform measures to highlight the characteristics of higher vocational education,then to further strengthen the practical teaching on the cultivation of higher vocational and technical personnel.

tittel: On the Open Community Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: The higher vocational is called Higher professional and technical education in other countries, and its development is closely relative to community. The development of the higher in community could help the development of local economy and popularization of higher education, and breaks the single and blocked mode of traditional higher to meet the requirements of personal development and life long education. To meet people's need for various ,strengthen community and economy exchange, and develop the open professional system, it is necessary to draw lessons from the development of community in other countries.

tittel: Exploration of the Features of Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: The knowledge-based economy era provides opportunities as well as the challenges for the development of our country’s higher education. Through analysing the problems exist in the aspects such as the educational concept,teaching model,education quality,education management and so on that higher education are faced with in the era of knowledge economy,it also puts forword the ways that by adjusting the hierarchy to strengthen the internal management system of higher education, strengthen the international cooperation ,to reduce the brain drain, to change the educational concepts and teaching models and so on ,in order to cultivate high-quality personnel to serve for the social economy

tittel: Study on Evaluation of Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: The rapid development of higher vocational education in China require that its evaluation should exert the effects of rectifying misunderstandings and reforming models. Therefore, the evaluation of higher vocational education should be regulated further: depending on evaluation theories, combining with educational characteristics and referring international experiences, and it should be deployed from the aspects of evaluation purpose, subject, object, principle, standard, content, mode, method and effect in term of system.

tittel: The Thinking of Standardization on Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: This paper mainly analyses that standardized construction plays an important role in higher vocational education.It can ensure the steady development and form the value communities in higher vocational education.It can promote the management standards in institute,clarify the words system of vocational technology,and promote the formation of vocational education system.Based on international and domestic standards for education,the paper puts forward the system framework of higher vocational educational standards,and introduces the practice of course construction standards at the institutional level.

tittel: On Curriculum Reform in Higher Vocational Education
kilde: Liaoning Higher Vocational Technical Institute Journal
sammendrag: Higher vocational education is a education which is ability orientation and its aim is to improve vocational ability. In order to adapt to this kind of education, curriculum system must be adjusted and combined, that is, offering curriculum based on vocational requirement, changing subject orientation to ability orientation and changing essence education to popular education.

tittel: Higher Vocational Education Thought in Guangxi
kilde: Science and Technology of West China
sammendrag: Guangxi higher vocational education on the present and future period of time will play what function? How to cultivate qualified students? In view of the above questions,through the analysis of higher vocational education and the characteristics of the Guangxi economy,education,etc,the article thinks that higher vocational education in Guangxi is the main purpose of service economy and satisfy demand.Education at the same time that to cultivate qualified students,should be further market survey,build the curriculum system and strengthen quality education.

tittel: Thoughts on Higher Vocational Education and Teaching
kilde: Journal of Changjiang Engineering Vocational College
sammendrag: Higher vocational colleges are booming in our country nowadays,but vocational education is still in the process of exploration,as it is not mature enough.So,problems such as bening quite confused and passive of the students who are the teaching center,drawbacks of the textbooks and the embarrassed situation of the basic courses in vocational colleges.

tittel: Internationalization of Higher Vocational Education in Europe
Development Strategy for Higher Vocational Education
kilde: Journal of Tangshan Vocational & Technical College
sammendrag: In order to realize connotation development of higher vocational education, we should adhere to the sustainable development and lifelong education realistically and truthfully 。 We should proceed from China's actual conditions, strengthen overall design and innovate while drawing lessons from other countries.

tittel: Advanced mathematics for higher vocational education
sammendrag: With the reform of higher vocational education,roles and functions of advanced mathematics have changed.Then the reseach centers on curricular construction,teaching materials,teaching methodology,and motivation of learners' interest.The research is to improve teaching quality and resolves problems.

tittel: Hot Issues on Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: This article initially gives a brief account of characteristics and current situation of higher vocational education.Then it presents some solutions to hot issues as follows: ① The quality of dual-qualified teachers as well as their skill should be improved;② Order–oriented training mode should be applied after the completion of basic courses for specialty.Meanwhile,terms to restrain enterprises and to protect students’ benefits are required to be included in the order;③ Professional ethics courses have to be transformed from normal moral education courses to those closely related to corresponding specialties and be provided separately;④ The teaching of professional knowledge should concentrate on laying a solid foundation for equipping students with core competivity for employment.

tittel: Discussion on Orientation of Higher Vocational Education
kilde: Journal of Jiangsu Teachers University of Technology
sammendrag: The training purpose of higher vocational education is nurturingblue-collar workers.Under the premise of it,we should clarify the school property,the scope of admissions,student employment,school char-acteristics and competitive positioning objects,and analysis the value orientation of higher vocational education.

tittel: The Social Responsibilities of Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: This article is about the social responsibilities of higher vocational education.It expounds the five connotations of these responsibilities,based on an understanding of the necessity for higher vocational education to realize its social service responsi bilities.Five approaches to fullfilling the responsibilities are suggested through an review of the practice by Fujian Polytechnic of Information Technology.

tittel: Higher Vocational Education: Critical Perspectives
kilde: University of Huddersfield Repository (University of Huddersfield)

tittel: On the Problems in the Development of Higher Vocational Education
kilde: Journal of Jiyuan Vocational and Technical College
sammendrag: Guided by the scientific development concept,higher vocational education should draft new development strategy and adopt the principle of service and direction of employment orientation to focus on teaching and improve the quality of teaching.Meanwhile,taking people as a dominant factor,higher vocational education focuses on both quality and quantity.Promotion the integration of production,teaching and research can improve the coordinated and sustained development of higher vocational education.

tittel: Status and Thinking of Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: Vocational education bears a major responsibility to nurture the form of high-level skills talent.Currently,the lack of the presence of higher vocational education practice teaching conditions,the concept behind the curriculum model behind the lack of Double Type Teachers and other problems.Teaching Factory mode by Singapore's revelation combined with the actual situation of our country,from schools and enterprise resource integration,the quality of teachers and corporate standards,improve the current of higher vocational education in the teaching model and enterprise integration.

tittel: Reflection on the Role of Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: It is accepted that in higher vocational education there exists a tendency of inaccurate orientation,neglecting their own advantages,being eager for large-scale,all-round colleges with aim above their reach,which directly impairs the sound development of higher vocational institutions.It is therefore of great necessity for them to properly recognize their own roles and functions and embrace the three key principles of meeting the needs of society,achieving maximized social contributions and maintaining sustainable development.Functional orientation shall then be performed in the areas of educational goal,teaching staff construction as well as teaching and learning system to reshape the higher vocational education with Chinese characteristics.

tittel: On the Financial Investment for Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: Financial investment plays an important role in the process of promoting the development of higher vocational education.With the development of vocational education,financial investment for higher vocational education also improved significantly,but there are still many problems,such as the total sum has gown but the magnitude is still small,the structure of spending arrangement is not reasonable enough,regional investment is imbalance,and financial investment management and operation are irrational.Therefore,we need to further adjust and optimize fiscal policy,strengthen the management functions of the government,change the way of financial investment and to build the financial performance evaluation system in order to increase the intensity of higher vocational eduncial support.

tittel: On Cost Control in Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: Cost control is the important topic in the Higher vocational colleges.The article analyzes the problems in the development of higher vocational colleges,such as teachers'teams building and training facilities censtruction,setting forth the feasible measures to raise the school benefit.

tittel: On the Internationalization of Higher Vocational Education in China
sammendrag: Due to the development of society and higher vocational education,higher vocational education must follow the trend of internationalization.The purpose of which is to combine the transnational and trans-cultural concepts and atmosphere with our management,teaching,research and social service functions and so on.It is helpful for bringing up talents with internationalized and high-qualified qualifications.These students are expected to have international vision and good competence.The core concept of internationalization of higher vocational education is supposed to be the internationalization of courses according to professional certificates in international general standards.The key concern is to bring up teachers with international accomplishment.

tittel: Concept of Quality in Higher Vocational Education
kilde: Exploration and Research of Vocational Education
sammendrag: How to enhancing the of higher vocational education is becoming an important subject. We should construct the higher vocational education system from the three respect, such as system of education inside the school, plural subjects security system, quality culture of universities and colleges, et, to form the scientific Concept of higher vocational education and guarantee the of higher vocational education.

tittel: On the Objectives of Curriculum for Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: The objective of curriculum for higher vocational education,which influences and restricts the daily teaching and learning activities of higher vocational education,is the final standard or expected result that the project for specialized courses tries to come up to after a certain period of education,the norm for guiding the process of curriculum establishment,the goal that a student is required to attain to in his knowlege,ability and attitude when he or she has finished a certain specialized course,the educational purpose and training goal embodied in curriculum,and the basis on which the curriculum contents for higher vocational education are chosen and the criterion for course evaluation.The curriculum development for higher vocational education is to embody such a mentality,for which the curriculum objective is to be orientated to integration of behavioural goal,generative goal and expressive goal.Such needs as students' healthy growth,social progress and professional development are to become the basis on which the objective of curriculum for higher vocational education.And methods,such as activity analysis,work analysis,goal and means and occupational analysis as well are to be used to establish the objective of curriculum for higher vocational education.

tittel: Exploration into the Characteristics of Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: Compared with regular higher education and secondary vocational education,higher vocational education has its own characteristics,which are shown in the training object,training modes,teaching method and process,specialty and curriculum arrangement,and the construction of teaching staff.

tittel: Reflection on the Management of Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: The development in society and advance in technology have two characteristics to modernization talents: solid knowledge and practical ability.Compared with other types of higher education,vocational education has its own particularity and superiority.We must pay more attention that the talents trained by current vocational education does not fit to the social needs so much.Modernization vocational educational environment needs to improve and innovate internal and external environment from the school itself,improve the students’ quality to contribute their force to social development.

tittel: On the Revelation of Foreign Higher Vocational Education
kilde: Journal of Tianjin Adult Higher Learning
sammendrag: The higher vocational education of our country has shown itself the unprecedented developing tendency. Yet it is necessary to study the vocational education of the developed country if the long-term existence and development under the background of economic globalization are expected. Therefore, it will be of important meaning for promoting the reform and construction of the higher vocational education of our country by studying the fruit of foreign higher vocational education and absorbing their experiences in running school.

tittel: The Development of China's Higher Vocational Education
kilde: Journal of Shenyang College of Education
sammendrag: Higher vocational education plays an important role in China's modernization.It is pointed out that though China's higher vocational education on the whole has made much progress,there are still some weak points,which hinders the development of China's economy and society.The problems existing in China's higher vocational education are explored and suggestions on how to ensure the healthy development of China's higher vocational education are put forward.

tittel: On the Significance of Mathematics in Higher Vocational Education
kilde: Journal of Tianjin Institute of Financial and Commercial Management
sammendrag: Mathematics,as the most common and the oldest subject,only can be matched by language and literature subject in every country.So it is very clear that the subject is irreplaceable.Mathematics plays a very important role in cultivating students’ moral and feelings,pursuits of the true,the good and the beauty and their innovation abilities.

tittel: Higher Vocational Education in Technological Perspective
kilde: Journal of Jiangsu Teachers University of Technology
sammendrag: Technology is both related closely to the science engineering and dependent.The dependent status is formed in the course of the scientization of technology and agglomerated by the evolution of the science to technology.The scientization of the technology and the technicalization of the science form the system of the technology-science.The landscape and lengthways development of the system of the technology-science needs the support of the special technical talents and higher vocational education.

tittel: On Cultivation Objective in Higher Vocational Education
English Teaching in Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: Higher vocational education in China has been in the primary period of development.There have been some problems existing in English teaching.The author analyses them and puts forward some countermeasures.The English teaching in higher vocational education needs continuous practice and consummation to achieve best results.

tittel: On the Logic of Value of Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: Higher vocational education carries the characters of both secondary vocational and technical education and higher education, and still it has its own feature. It is necessary,from the logic of value, to identify its importance; to explore its relevance ; to regard it as a whole and to care the influence of the value choices of subjects related on its state and forms.

tittel: On Teaching Reform of Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: Higher vocational education,as an important part of higher education,has undertakes the duty to cultivate high-technique and applicable talents oriented to production,construction,management and service,and played an important role in promoting the popularization of higher education.The traditional education conceptions can't realize the objective to cultivate high quality and technical talents.To meet the demand of social development,we must reform and improve our higher vocational education teaching.

tittel: The Culture of Higher Vocational Education in China
sammendrag: This article mainly deals with the importance of culture in the construction of higher vocational education,states howto inherit the human spirit in Chinese culture,what should we learn from the advanced vocational education in Western philosophy.So,it would gradually form with Chinese characteristics and cultural system of higher vocational education,and return to education to promote vocational education that attributes of human nature,to prevent excessive tool of high vocational education that caused by the absence of culture in China.

tittel: Analysis of the Adaptability of Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: The connotation of the adaptability of higher vocational education is embodied in the unification of passivity and pre-activeness,which can be understood through the dimensions of the adaptive object,development time and stage of development.Examining on the adaptability of China's present higher vocational education with the dimensions mentioned above,we find out it is a survival type,which adapts to the society and the reality,and it reflects as the undue trend of instrumentalism.The orientation of the adaptability of higher vocational education should be development-oriented and restricted by some necessities such as selectivity,initiative and applicableness.

tittel: Problems and countermeasures of higher vocational education
kilde: Journal of Chongqing University of Arts and Sciences
sammendrag: Higher vocational education is the most important part of higher education.The paper analyses the present situation and the reasons of higher vocational education in China as well as the existing problem and puts forward the countermeasures to deal with it.While China is in the period of developing vocational education,higher vocational education should grasp the opportunity and continuously improve talent training quality so as to serves the local economy development.

tittel: On Practice Teaching in Higher Vocational Education
kilde: Liaoning Higher Vocational Technical Institute Journal
sammendrag: Practice teaching is an important component in higher vocational education, and it directly affects the quality of skilled person training. But at present, there are many problems in it. Some measures and methods have been put forward too in the paper.

tittel: On the creativity education in Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: Creative education is to develop students creativity is the core of education,with the society to talented person demand rise,universities must focus on the cultivation of creative talents,and to contribute to the development of country.This paper focuses on the discussion of creative education to higher vocational education significance,elaborated carry out creative education in higher vocational education the necessity,feasibility and conditions,and to the higher vocational education in the construction of creative education and puts forward concrete suggestions and measures.

tittel: Developing Capability in Higher Vocational Education
kilde: Journal of Zhejiang Business Technology Institute
sammendrag: The article analyses and describes the problem of developing student's professional capability in higher vocational education. It puts forward the definition and intension of capability and points out some problems in developing capability in current higher vocational education. The article gives some ideas and methods on how to strengthen the development of professional capability in higher vocational education.

tittel: On the Allocation of Expenditure in Higher Vocational Education
kilde: Journal of Jilin Institute of Architecture & Civil Engineering
sammendrag: Higher vocational education concerns industrial structure optimization and technology structure upgrading,so the government should undertake the responsibility of developing higher vocational education.However,higher vocational education has not been paid due attention,and there exist some problems on the allocation of the present expenditure.Thus,relevant measures should be taken to optimize the allocation of higher vocational education expenditure and maximize the efficiency.

tittel: On Rights Relation in Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: The essay,under market economy,makes a elementary discussion about the right relation in higher vocational education,hence it expatiates the relation of the basic right relation,the core right relation and the procedural right relation.The essay states that the right relation in the field of higher vocational education is one of the admixture of public right and private one,of both antinomy and unification,among which private right relation is full of rich connotation as it is in the value center of higher vocational education relation under market economy and constitutes a core right relation of higher vocational education.

tittel: Higher vocational education to the need for direction
kilde: Journal of Qiqihar Junior Teachers' College
sammendrag: Paying less attention to the practice with too much importance attached to the theory is prominent characteristic in higher tech-nical and vocational education,and that is far from the training goal of the advanced vocational education.According to the actual needs of social posts,higher vocational education should put emphasis on utility and the training of students’comprehensive operation ability.The paper states the views in the aspect of the construction of integrating teaching.

tittel: On Characteristics in the Development of Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: In recent years, higher vocational education has developed into an important part of higher education. But due to lack of systematic understanding of higher vocational education, there are some derivations in educational practice. This paper points out the current problems existing in aspects of goal orientation, training model, curriculum, employment demands, teaching practice and cooperative development and puts forward some ideas based on others' experiences.

tittel: On the Ecological Development of Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: The ecological development of higher vocational education should be based on ecological niche,ecological chain and ecologicalization.From the perspective of ecological niche,higher vocational education should strengthen the characteristic development,promote the sustainable development,and broaden the ecological space by the dislocation expansion,moderate development and virtual operations.From the perspective of ecological chain,higher vocational education should strengthen structural optimization,competitive cooperation and connotative development,to promote the ecological integrity,enhance the openness of ecological chain and realize the sustainability of ecology.From the perspective of ecologicalization,higher vocational education should strengthen the humanities education,curriculum integration,respect and develop the student individuality,cultivate the students' developmental quality,multiple ability and innovative potential,and ultimately promote the sustainable development of the students.

tittel: On the encouraging mechanism of higher vocational education
sammendrag: Encouragement,which is a kind of management function in reality,has played an important role in higher vocational education.Model encouragement,target encouragement,negative encouragement and honour encouragement all have their own characteristics and they have been widely used in higher vocational education.The combination of material encouragement with mental encouragement,positive encouragement with negative encouragement,and long-term encouragement with short-term encouragement has formed several couples of philosophical categories,which are dialectical and have directive function in practical management of higher vocational education.

tittel: Higher Vocational Education Calls for Innovative Education Reconsideration on the "Vocational Character" and "Higher Character" of Higher Vocational Education
kilde: Journal of Wenzhou Vocational and Technical College
sammendrag: 高职教育需要创新教育。创新教育的根本任务是要进行教育创新、知识创新和人才创新，着眼于学生的未来，提高学生的综合素质和创新能力。在高职教育中开展创新教育，应使“职业性”和“高等性”达到高度统一，从而使“高等性”的要求成为不同职业领域创新教育活动的基础和支柱。

tittel: The Contradictions in the Development of Higher Vocational Education and Strategies

tittel: Reform and Exploration of Examination in Higher Vocational Education
kilde: Journal of Tangshan Vocational & Technical College
sammendrag: Examination is an important part of teaching.It can check the knowledge that the students have acquired,presenting the problems that exist in teaching and evaluate the teaching result of course objectively.The paper puts forward the proposal that examination system and method of higher vocational education need to be improved.What is suggested in this paper is to give up some irrational system and method in examinations and construct the examination of higher vocational education adoptable to quality —— oriented education based on the break-through and reform of the existing one.

tittel: Develop Community Strategies of Higher Vocational Education

tittel: Programming Basis Courses in Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: Improving the teaching quality is the important guarantee of cultivating high-quality professional skill talents.How to improve the teaching quality becomes the primary task of vocational colleges.For the students in computer department,programming basis courses is the foundation of subsequent professional skills courses,but because it is boring and difficult to understand,so it is difficult to attract students' attention.To improve teaching quality,it is necessary to analyze from the teaching present situation,the concept,mode,process and evaluation etc,so as to form an effective teaching method.

tittel: Research On The Interior Teaching Of Higher Vocational Education

tittel: The Quality-oriented Education in Higher Vocational Education
kilde: Journal of Yueyang Vocational and Technical College

The quality structure of higher vocational students can be asserted as cultural quality, vocational quality and ideological-moral quality---three essential factors. To fully promote quality-oriented education focused on vocational quality-oriented education at present, this paper points out that this theory presents the concrete expression to highlight vocational moral education, to construct curriculum systems based on vocational career, to advance curriculum reformation with the main thread of professional abilities, to execute double certificates system that aims at vocational skills, and to create campus culture rich in vocational education characteristics.

tittel: The development and achievement of higher vocational education in Henan

tittel: Good and Fast Development of Higher Vocational Education

tittel: Probe into the Curriculum Reform of Higher Vocational Education

tittel: Higher Vocational Education In the Views Of Scientific Development

tittel: On Problem of Education Equity of Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: Education equity is the basis to gradually eliminate duality-structure of city and countryside,to sustain nation stability,and to realize social equity.To propel education equity is the key approach to narrowing the gap of labor resources of different social groups.With different social formations,discussion about the process of education equity and elaboration on the tendency of human-oriented are made from the aspects of labor and human resources.Meanwhile,analysis is also made of the deviation of current situation of education equity and what should be done about education equity.It is put forward that effective measures,such as scientific guidance,adjustment of educational policies and harmonious circumstances of campus,can advance the realization of education equity.

tittel: Logistics English Teaching in Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: This paper analyses the common problems in current vocational colleges Logistics English teaching,such as lacking of teachers,aging teaching material,single and boring teaching methods,aimed at those problems,the author raise some countermeasures of using practical teaching materials,strengthen the teachers' group,rich teaching methods.

tittel: Characteristics of Higher Vocational Education in Germany and Australia
sammendrag: This paper examines the vocational education system in Germany and Australia, and summarizes some characteristics which are of great inspiration to China in exploring its own higher vocational education.

tittel: The Characteristics and Enlightenment of Germany Higher Vocational Education

At present, our higher vocationa l education enters a new developing phase. with thorough understanding of the ch aracteristics of Germany higher vocational education, we can profit from its adv anced experience, so that it will have the positive influence to the development of our country's higher vocational education.

tittel: On the construction of the comprehensive curricula for the higher vocational education
sammendrag: The higher vocational education as a whole is rather new in China,let alone the curricular construction,pattern and model,which demand an urgent reform of the traditional model or curricular system.This gives rise to a new curricular system in the higher vocational education,which is known as task-based model of comprehensive and practical curricula.The purpose of the model is to enhance the comprehensive competence of the students.

tittel: Discussion on Teaching Strategy of Higher Vocational Education

tittel: On Problems and Solutions in Current Higher Vocational Education

Task driven project-oriented teaching operation is difficult, work-integrated learning and alternating operation is difficult, unreasonable curriculum, a lack of high quality teaching material, and teachers' technical level is not qualified for vocational teaching. Aiming at these problems some countermeasures are put forward.

tittel: The Application of “Micro-Lesson” in Higher Vocational Education
sammendrag: With teaching video the main carrier of micro-lesson, it is to carry out the whole process of teaching and learning activities aimed at a certain point. Vocational students generally have low interest in learning and their learning enthusiasm is not high, thus, to develop a micro-lesson that is appropriate for higher vocational students is particularly important. The materials of micro-video are the bases for the production of micro-video, which include pictures, recordings, animation, music, video clips, and so on. Recording them into micro-video and then applying the video to vocational teaching, we can stimulate the leaning enthusiasm of students in order to achieve the transformation of vocational teaching and learning concepts.

tittel: On Training of Core Competitiveness of Higher Vocational Education

tittel: The Practical Teaching of Accounting in Higher Vocational Education

tittel: The appropriate education on the tertiary vocational education

tittel: On the coordinated development of tertiary vocational education and regional economy
Can the VET system be a blueprint for “tertiary vocational education”?
sammendrag: This chapter discusses the transfer of principles of (dual) apprenticeships into applied higher education courses. We can observe this trend in the “dual universities” in the federal state of Baden-Württemberg, Germany, as well as in the concept of “cooperative education” at colleges in Ontario, Canada. Since the general framework of VET differs highly between these two countries, it seems especially interesting to compare these different approaches. When transferring VET into higher education, we can also talk of a form of “hybridity”, which means combining academic and vocational learning in a new institutional setting. We focus our research on a literature and document analysis as well as on a preliminary typology of hybrid qualifications (HQs). Based on our typology, we can classify both approaches as HQs of type 3, which represent “applied or dual courses in higher education”. Both “tertiary vocational education” programs show similarities by sharing the political motivation to establish higher education programs that are oriented more closely towards the needs of the labour market, even if the initial standing of VET differs strongly in both countries. Differences can be detected in the acceptance of the programs in the respective labour markets as well as in the education system.

tittel: Personnel Training Mode Renovation on the Tertiary Vocational Education and Training

tittel: Returns on Tertiary Vocational Education and Gender Differences: Evidence from China
sammendrag: Higher education plays a crucial role in human capital investment, especially in China, where it includes tertiary vocational education (junior college), undergraduate, and postgraduate programs. However, in China, a cultural preference for academic over vocational learning, coupled with low social recognition and uncertain employment prospects, has led to the neglect of tertiary vocational education. This sector is vital for producing skilled professionals essential to China's industrial advancement and the manufacturing sector's rise in the global value chain.This article focuses on the returns of tertiary vocational education and the gender disparities in these returns. With China's demographic dividend shrinking and its manufacturing sector undergoing transformation, understanding the return on investment in vocational education, along with gender differences, is of both practical and theoretical significance. Using data from the CFPS of China, the study estimates the trends and gender differences in the return on tertiary vocational education from 2016 to 2020, employing Mincer's income equation and OLS, followed by a robustness test.

tittel: Basic standards for establishing the specialty of clinical medical laboratory test in tertiary vocational education

Tertiary vocational education; Technology of clinical medical laboratory test; Specialties setting; Basic standards

tittel: Elaborating socio-cultural narratives for educational change: Five case studies from tertiary vocational education
kilde: Wintec Research Archive (Waikato Institute of Technology)
sammendrag: The Te Arawhiti Māori Crown Relations Capability Framework (MCRCF) identifies six focal areas in which agencies and individuals have to develop capability: understanding racial equity and institutional racism; New Zealand history and the Treaty of Waitangi; worldview knowledge; tikanga/kawa; te reo Māori; and engagement with Māori. As a subsidiary of the newly formed Te Pūkenga, Waikato Institute of Technology (Wintec) has initiated the Tōia Mai Excellence Framework (TMEF, 2020) in response. Our focus in this report is on educator capability development in level-1 to level-3 programmes at the institute, and how training on the New Zealand Certificate in Adult Literacy and Numeracy Education (Vocational) (NZCALNE-Voc) creates a firm launch-pad for elaborating socio-cultural narratives that are consistent with Ministry of Education, Te Arawhiti and Te Pūkenga expectations. We argue that NZCALNE(Voc) training provides a stepping-stone from the unfamiliar to the comfortable on the Te Arawhiti scale (MCRCF, 2018). \nIn five case studies from the training programme, we illustrate how 18 Te Reo Māori terms, integrated into lesson planning and implementation, were activated as meaning-making lenses to raise kaimahi awareness of te ao Māori and the significance of this world view for their pedagogical practices. Our aim was to show how Māori terms could be deliberately enacted in educator (kaiako) teaching practices. Using collaborative lesson-planning, lesson observations and one-on-one interviews with four kaimahi, we attempted to place these elements of socio-cultural narratives, consistent with the Te Arawhiti and Tōia Mai frameworks, front of mind. Applying qualitative research methods, we found that when these terms were clustered, they could be used to capture complex, mutually supportive socio-cultural meanings. We triangulated our analysis of the lesson observations with data obtained from kaimahi in structured one-on-one interviews premised on the assumption that their personally held meanings were a worthy starting point for elaborating their pedagogical belief systems. We showed that laddering up and laddering down pedagogical constructs could be used to develop practice-based descriptors of meaning-making lenses in action whether personally held or otherwise. We concluded that externalised narrative accounts of personally held (and known) pedagogical lenses were valuable points of departure in embracing the meaning-making potential of the Māori concepts and socio-cultural frameworks in question. Kaimahi, we sensed, had to develop the flexibility and capacity to don any relevant constructs in exploring their implications for their teaching practices. \n

tittel: THE EFFECT OF MULTIMODAL LEARNING STRATEGIES ON ENGLISH LANGUAGE PROFICIENCY IN TERTIARY VOCATIONAL EDUCATION: A COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS
sammendrag: This research aims to explore the ways in which Learning Management Systems (LMS) significantly contribute to English language proficiency in tertiary vocational education, more especially in connection with multimodal learning approaches. The use of multimodal learning—visual, auditory, textual, and interactive modes—has shown promise to improve language acquisition. Consequently, vocational colleges are using these innovative pedagogical approaches more and more to satisfy the rising demand for graduates ready to start their careers. This comparative study aims to find the ways in which these approaches—supported by learning management systems including Blackboard, Google Classroom, and Moodle—have an impact on English language competency of students in the domains of reading, writing, listening, and speaking. LMSs enable instructors to modify their lectures to fit the demands of their students and inspire student autonomy by providing free access to multimedia material, cooperative tools, exams, and tailored feedback. The results show that students who engaged in multimodal learning using a LMS had far greater degrees of English proficiency and were much more engaged than their classmates. Furthermore emphasised in the paper is the fact that multimodal learning techniques' efficacy is much enhanced by organised LMS supporting ongoing interaction and learning at one's own pace. The findings show that adding LMS helps students acquire the kind of autonomous study habits required for vocational programs, therefore augmenting the accessibility and participation of English as a Second Language (ESL) sessions. The research ends with suggestions that vocational colleges should use LMS-driven multimodal techniques into English classrooms in order to help students enhance their language abilities and better equip them for global communication in technical and professional domains. This would enable pupils to produce better translations.

tittel: A FORECAST OF THE GROWING IMPORTANCE OF TERTIARY VOCATIONAL EDUCATION (T-VET) IN NORWAY BOTH AS AN EDUCATIONAL PATH AND AS A SUPPLIER TO THE LABOR MARKET, BY 2030

tittel: The Effect of an Education-driven Labor Supply Shock on Firms’ R&D Personnel
kilde: Zurich Open Repository and Archive (University of Zurich)
sammendrag: This paper examines the effect of an R&D-specific labor supply shock produced by the establishment of tertiary vocational education institutions teaching and conducting applied R&D, the Universities of Applied Sciences, on the R&D personnel of private firms. We apply a difference-in-differences model, exploiting a quasi-natural experiment in the 1990s in Switzerland, the staggered establishment of these institutions. Using repeated cross-sectional data from the Swiss Earnings Structure Survey, we can precisely measure the R&D personnel of private firms, i.e., how much R&D personnel a firm employs and how much a firm spends on its R&D personnel in terms of wages. The education-driven labor supply shock has positive effects on both the percentage of R&D personnel and the wages paid to this personnel. Our assessments of effect heterogeneity suggest that these effects are driven by firms with 50 to 99 employees and firms in the manufacturing sector increasing their R&D personnel.

tittel: Transition Into Tertiary Education After VET and the Role of the Work Area – a Longitudinal Study on Gender Segregation in the Field of Social Care
kilde: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
sammendrag: Summary Vocational education and training play a key role in the Swiss educational system. One of the most frequently chosen apprenticeships is Certified Social Care Worker (CSCW). After certification, these graduates have the option of working in the profession, attending tertiary vocational education, or changing to a profession outside the social sector. Studies on the choice of study at upper secondary and university tertiary level point to gender-typical choice behaviour. So far, little research has been done on whether and how gender-typical choices are perpetuated when entering a profession or attending vocational tertiary education. This study aims to close this gap and, using the example of the social sector, examines the role that gender plays in career and educational decisions after graduation as CSCW. Since the social sector is considered a women’s domain but includes various areas of work that are occupied to different degrees by women and men, it is of particular interest whether the career and educational decisions of former CSCW apprentices are also influenced by the area of work in which they were trained. The analyses are based on data from a longitudinal study. The results show a significant influence of gender and the chosen work area on the CSCWs career and educational pathway. The findings are discussed in the context of individual and institutional characteristics in the social sector.

tittel: Measuring Quality Teaching: Developing a Process Focused Framework
sammendrag: There is international acknowledgement that the ability of industry and nations to meet the competitive challenges of a growing global economy is often determined by the acquired industry relevant, knowledge, skills and attitudes of its workforce. A significant factor impacting on the level of success achieved by individuals can be directly related to the quality of the teaching experienced in formal Tertiary Vocational Education and Training (TVET) educational settings. The purpose of this paper is to explore, through a documented Chinese case-study of Tianjin City Vocational College, how quality teaching can be measured. The project methodology used was based on an intuitive-rational approach segmented into three (3) phases; preparation, process and reporting. The preparation phase focused on defining quality teaching and developing four research instruments to investigate quality teaching practices. The process phase involved gathering and analysing data generated from questionnaires, classroom observations and interviews. The reporting phase presented the findings of the research to relevant stakeholders. In reviewing the initial findings, it was acknowledged that the framework proposed does not match other quality evaluation methodologies in this area. This is partially because this evaluation methodology used focused on the actual teaching and learning experienced by participants. This measurement of the process at the point of delivery, rather than the outcomes at the point of completion, provides a detailed overview of the current educational climate and teaching practices of the institution being investigated. The data generated allows institutional response to improving teaching quality to be pro-active, impacting on current teaching practices, rather than reactive, focusing on past teaching practices. It was concluded that the evaluation framework created, and the associated research instruments developed, were robust and reliable. It was argued that they could be used with confidence by TVET institutions who want to pro-actively improve the teaching quality experienced by their learners.

tittel: Train the teacher programmes: Wintec/Chengdu University collaboration
kilde: Wintec Research Archive (Waikato Institute of Technology)
sammendrag: The Waikato Institute of Technology (Wintec) in Hamilton, New Zealand, is a government run tertiary vocational education institution offering programmes up to degree and postgraduate level. For a number of years Wintec has offered Train the Trainer/Teacher type programmes to staff from various overseas institutions, including universities and hospitals. The purpose of these is to offer groups of professional staff a unique opportunity for professional development, studying a programme in adult education in a Western country, and taught fully in the medium of English. These international programmes are tailored to suit varying lengths of time, but what does not vary is the huge impact on staff of the experience of living and studying for six weeks to six months in New Zealand with both their Chinese and new Wintec colleagues. This has consistently proved to be not only a memorable personal and professional experience for individual staff, but also one which the organisations sending staff to New Zealand perceive as a valuable institutional experience. From Wintec’s point of view also, it provides a genuine opportunity to get closer to understanding the world of other academics and their students, and to appreciate the different approaches to education both historically and in our modern world. It is an opportunity to learn from one another collegially, to share understandings, and to engage in mutual research. This presentation presents an overview of the particular nature of this programme offered at Wintec and discusses the collaborative relationship with Chengdu University, China.

tittel: Discussing Penetration of Humanity Accomplishment in Chinese Course Teaching in Tertiary Vocational Education
sammendrag: Five-year tertiary vocational education should focus on the cultivation of students' humanity spirit.Chinese course teaching plays a vital role in cultivating students' humanity spirit and accomplishment.We should carry out the cultivation and penetration of humanity accomplishment by various methods in Chinese course teaching.

tittel: Application of Students Standardized Patients in Internal Medicine Practice Teaching of Tertiary Vocational Education
sammendrag: Objective To discuss the application of students standardized patients in internal medicine practice teaching of Tertiary Vocational Education.Methods 570 clinical medicine students were randomly divided into two groups.347 students of four classes in trial group were taught with the SSP teaching method,And 223 students of three classes in control group were taught with traditional teaching method.The scores of collecting history of disease were analyzed by using PEMS3.1.Results the average score of the trial group are significantly higher than that of the control group.Conclusion The application of students standardized patients in internal medicine practice teaching of tertiary vocational education is a good teaching method.

tittel: Conceptions of assessment among tertiary vocational education and training students across school and workplace settings in China
sammendrag: Students' understanding of the purposes and uses of assessment has been measured using the Chinese Students’ Conceptions of Assessment (C-SCoA) inventory. The C-SCoA has a hierarchical structure with a single second-order factor (i.e., School Quality) predicting seven subordinate factors. However, previous studies with the C-SCoA have been limited to academic-track students in tertiary institutional settings. Using a sample of 1,130 final-year students in China's tertiary vocational education and training (VET) institutions, the present study offers partial validation evidence for the C-SCoA instrument with vocational-track students. Confirmatory factor analysis indicated a better fit of the data to an eight-factor correlated model compared to the original hierarchical model. The eight-factor correlated model was invariant between school and workplace settings. Taken together, the results suggest that the C-SCoA is a psychometrically sound instrument for investigating VET students' conceptions of assessment across school and workplace settings.

tittel: On the Convergence of Secondary and Tertiary Vocational Education in Tibet: The Only Sustainable Way to Develop Tibetan Vocational Education
sammendrag: The principal objective of the convergence of secondary and tertiary vocation education in Tibet is to upgrade the social adaptability of skill-centered talents.On the basis of grasping the essence of such a convergence and referring to the theories and practices of the convergence of secondary and tertiary vocation education,the paper put forward the following suggestions for the sustainable development of vocational education in Tibet: to choose a schooling length for convergence suitable for the convergence of vocational education in Tibet by drawing on successful stories home and abroad and to explore the paths for key convergence that extends through the Tibetan vocational education.

tittel: Sharing and refining research management best practice across the tumultuous New Zealand tertiary vocational education sector
kilde: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
sammendrag: Abstract: In early 2019, the Government announced that New Zealand’s sixteen independent institutes of technology and polytechnics (ITPs) and nine industry training organisations (ITOs) would be unified into a single national entity called Te Pūkenga – New Zealand Institute of Skills and Technology. This unification began in stages from April 2020, creating a single provider with over 9,000 staff, a new head office and regional structure, and serving 270,000 students at more than 90 sites around the country. However, as of November 2023 minimal unification of research management functions or structures had taken place within Te Pūkenga, leaving the former ITP research offices still operationally independent. In December 2023, the new Government announced that Te Pūkenga would be dissolved and replaced with eight to ten institutions, and as of April 2024 no further details are known about the future structure of the sector. This presentation will explore and reflect on the opportunities and challenges that have arisen while collaborating on research management across our unifying and now de-unifying sector. These will include the achievements of an informal community of practice founded by the research managers and rangahau Māori leaders of the independent ITPs; the strategies used to maintain continuity of research management functions across Te Pūkenga through major organisational change; and how working together as a sector has facilitated our participation in new academic spaces and organisations including ARMS.

tittel: Examining theory–skill and summative–formative tensions across school and workplace assessment in China’s tertiary vocational education and training
sammendrag: Abstract This study explores tensions between theory and skills, and between summative and formative assessments across school and workplace settings in four disciplines within Chinese tertiary vocational education and training (VET) institutions. One hundred sixty-six institutional policy documents from four disciplines (computer sciences, food sciences, health sciences, and mechanical and electrical engineering) were analysed using a structural topic modelling approach. Additionally, individual interviews were conducted with 17 workplace and school instructors from the four selected disciplines, and one student focus group was organised per discipline (total n = 20). The interview and focus group transcripts were processed with inductive content analysis. Results show that curricula are overly theoretical and summative. Summative theory-focused written examinations remain dominant, while coursework assessments, which should be formative with feedback, are often used to contribute towards final grades. In addition, school teachers lack sufficient industrial experience to instruct practical skills. Students in workplace settings have limited opportunities for skill development, largely due to economic efficiency considerations. Partnerships between educational institutions and workplace organisations appear mostly shallow. Students often secure internships on their own, and school instructors provide minimal support during internships. Additionally, practical barriers to implementing formative assessments include teacher workload and low assessment expertise. Overall, the goals of VET and assessment reforms regarding skill development and formative assessments are largely unrealised.

tittel: Comparative Study of Progression Pathway from Secondary to Tertiary Vocational Education in US,UK and Australia——from the Perspective of System and Mechanism

tittel: On Realistic Foundation for Educational Brand Name Establishment in Tertiary Vocational Colleges
sammendrag: With growing value of brand names, the competition between tertiary institutions is not the competition in terms of cost but in terms of brand names. The positive and sustainable development of tertiary vocational education rests on the portrayal of brand names. Consequently, tertiary vocational education should be committed to generating itself ideal growing environments with the view to upgrading its principal and competitive capacity.

tittel: The study of the higher vocational education appraisal system of the guidance of job-hunting
sammendrag: Through the analysis on the appraisal organization and the appraisal operational mechanism of tertiary education in countries like USA,France,United Kingdom,Australia and New Zealand etc.,and through the setting up of the appraisal standard and the index system,and the makeup of appraisal experts,this article raised existing problems in our domestic tertiary vocational education appraisal.The conclusion of the study pointed out that the tertiary education appraisal index system should shift its focus from the process to the result of the appraisal.What's more,the appraisal on the expertise of the school from students and future employers of the students should be highlighted.Agencies to appraise tertiary vocational education should be set up and also a bank of various kinds of exporters for appraisal purpose.Professional appraisal index system should also be set up with a focus on the results.

tittel: Development of the educational and professional structure of pupils and students in secondary and tertiary vocational education in the Czech Republic and in regions of the Czech Republic and the position of young people in the labor market compared to the situation in the European Union 2015/16
kilde: Digital Repository (National Repository of Grey Literature)
sammendrag: Publikace informuje o vývoji vzdělanostní struktury středního vzdělávání prostřednictvím vývoje počtů a podílů nově přijatých žáků do 1. ročníků (u víceletých gymnázií v ročnících odpovídajících 1. ročníku SŠ) a o vývoji počtů přijatých žáků do nástavbového a vyššího odborného vzdělávání, a to vše i v rozlišení dle krajů. Druhá část publikace se zabývá postavením mladých osob na trhu práce v ČR a v zemích EU. Pozornost je věnována jejich vzdělanostní úrovni, předčasným odchodům ze vzdělávání a nezaměstnanosti, tentokrát i v porovnání místních a cizinců. tittel: Development of the educational and vocational structure of pupils and students in secondary and tertiary vocational education in the Czech Republic and in regions of the Czech Republic and the position of young people in the labor market compared to the situation in the European Union - 2016/17
kilde: Digital Repository (National Repository of Grey Literature)
sammendrag: The publication informs about the development of the educational structure of secondary education through the development of the numbers and shares of newly admitted pupils in 1st grade (for multi-year grammar schools in years corresponding to 1st year of secondary school) and on the development of the number of admitted pupils in further education and higher vocational education, by region. The material also provides data on the development of the branch structure of secondary and higher education broken down by group of branches, incl. graphs and tables for the years 2011 to 2016. The second part of the publication deals with the position of young people on the labor market in the Czech Republic and in the EU countries. Attention is paid to their participation in secondary vocational education in the individual countries as a whole and in the composition according to the degree of study. Data on the share of industry in youth employment, vacancies in labor markets and youth unemployment are also reported. Migration crisis is also mentioned.
